column1: # Shared HNSW id_map integrity cases. Every entry in id_map must name a slot
#   id_map[k] == i  implies  i < count  and  ext_ids[i] == k
# Checking only length and value range accepted files where an external id
# resolved to another slot's vector, so reads returned the right bytes under
# The converse does NOT hold: a slot absent from id_map is a tombstone, not
# corruption. Those cases are engine-specific and live in each engine's own
# test rather than here, because the Rust engine supports deletion and the
# `ext_ids` and `id_map` describe the `count` live slots. `id_map` entries are
# `key:value` pairs; an empty list is written as `-`.
